objective: The fight presentation pass: impact effects (hit-stop, sparks, camera punch, bigger flinch, power-attack charge and landing), visible arrows and spell bolts for archers and mages, per-species animal attacks with a win pose and a defeat reaction, and fight rhythm (a slow-motion beat on the killing blow, a power-attack camera cut-in, a skip button). Archers and mages fire a visible arrow or spell bolt that lands when the log says
Every animal and variant has its own attack clip (with a fallback), and the surviving team shows a win pose
A slow-motion beat on the killing blow and a power-attack camera cut-in, and a skip button that leaves the fight through wave_done
No script errors, effects cleaned up after a fight, and desktop frame time not noticeably worse with 3 vs 3 fighters
